description.en: The task flow ID. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to query the ID of the task flow.

descriptions.zh:
### 注意事项
新增的边需要满足以下限制，否则将无法成功添加：
1. 指定的边端点存在于DagId指定的任务流DAG图中。 
2. 添加后有向边后，DAG图不出现环。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Usage notes

An edge can be created only when the following conditions are met:

1.  The start and end nodes of the edge exist in the directed acyclic graph (DAG) of the task flow specified by DagId.
2.  After the edge is created, the DAG does not contain loops.
